notes: CANONICAL own-paper for the CrossHAR baseline (ConSE tier). Published in Proc. ACM IMWUT (UbiComp) Vol.8 No.2, Article 64, pp.64:1-64:26, May 2024. No arXiv or open-access preprint exists; Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar report the only OA copy as the ACM 'hybrid' PDF at https://dl.acm.org/doi/pdf/10.1145/3659597, which is Cloudflare-protected and could NOT be downloaded via curl (returns a 'Just a moment' bot-challenge HTML page, ~5.7KB). Therefore saved the canonical ACM landing page (full abstract) to webpage.html, fetched via the Wayback snapshot 20241114223031 since the live ACM page is also Cloudflare-blocked. Official code: https://github.com/kingdomrush2/CrossHAR (author Zhiqing Hong, Rutgers; 22 stars; NO LICENSE file). Cross-check notes from README+abstract: transformer-based (LIMU-BERT-style) model. Pipeline = 3 stages: (1) sensor-data-generation-principle augmentation of raw IMU, (2) HIERARCHICAL self-supervised pretraining combining masked reconstruction (model_masked_*.pt) and temporal contrastive learning (model_TC_*.pt), (3) fine-tune on a small labeled subset of the SOURCE dataset, then evaluate cross-dataset with NO access to target during training. Eval datasets: UCI-HAR, MotionSense, Shoaib, HHAR. Dataset preprocessing version '20_120' = 20 Hz sampling, window length 120 samples (=6 s); 6-channel (accel+gyro) IMU. Config flags: -lr label_rate (finetune data ratio, e.g. 0.1), -am augment_method, -a mask_cfg. Headline claim: outperforms SOTA by 10.83% accuracy on unseen target datasets. Key design point vs domain adaptation: does NOT require target data during training (domain generalization, not adaptation). pdf_url left blank because no PDF was successfully downloaded; paper.pdf is NOT present, only webpage.html.
